questions.question: What is a patent and what does it protect?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A patent protects a new invention that is capable of industrial application. Term is 20 years from filing date.

questions.question: Who can apply for a patent in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: True and first inventor or their assignee or legal representative.

questions.question: What inventions cannot be patented in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Non-patentable: discoveries, mathematical methods, mental acts, business methods, traditional knowledge, plants, animals, etc.

questions.question: How long is patent protection valid in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 20 years from the date of filing of the application.

questions.question: What is the fee for filing a patent application in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Fees vary by applicant type (individual/startup/small entity/large entity). Check current schedule.

questions.question: What is a provisional patent application?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A provisional specification can be filed without complete specification, providing 12 months to file complete specification.

questions.question: What is prior art in Indian patent law?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Prior art includes prior publication, prior use, prior knowledge that affects novelty.

questions.question: What is compulsory licensing of a patent?
questions.ground_truth_notes: After 3 years from grant, any person may apply for compulsory license on specific grounds.

questions.question: How do I file a patent application in India step by step?
questions.expected_provision: Manual of Patent Practice and Procedure
questions.ground_truth_notes: File application, pay fees, examination request, FER, reply, grant or refusal.

questions.question: What is Section 8 of the Patents Act?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 8 requires applicant to disclose information about foreign patent applications.

questions.question: What is a trademark and what can be registered as a trademark?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A trademark is a mark that distinguishes goods/services. Can be word, logo, shape, sound, color combination.

questions.question: मैं अपने स्टार्टअप के ब्रांड नाम को ट्रेडमार्क कैसे करूं?
questions.ground_truth_notes: TM-A form, filing at CGPDTM, examination, opposition period, registration.

questions.question: How long does trademark registration take in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Can take 18 months to 3+ years depending on objections and opposition.

questions.question: What is the difference between TM and R symbols?
questions.ground_truth_notes: TM = unregistered mark. ® = registered trademark. Using ® on unregistered mark is an offence.

questions.question: What is Rule 23 of the Trade Marks Rules 2017?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Rule 23 relates to registration of trademark, conditions for registration.

questions.question: What are absolute grounds for refusal of trademark registration?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Marks devoid of distinctive character, descriptive marks, generic terms, deceptive marks.

questions.question: How do I oppose a trademark registration in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Opposition must be filed within 4 months of publication in Trade Marks Journal.

questions.question: How long is trademark registration valid in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years, renewable for further periods of 10 years.

questions.question: ট্রেডমার্ক রেজিস্ট্রেশন কীভাবে করতে হয়?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Trademark registration procedure in India.

questions.question: Mere startup ke logo aur brand name ko trademark kaise protect karein?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Logo can be registered as device mark, brand name as word mark.

questions.question: What does copyright protect in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Original literary, dramatic, musical, artistic works, cinematographic films, sound recordings.

questions.question: How long does copyright last in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Life of author + 60 years for literary/dramatic/musical/artistic works.

questions.question: Is software protectable by copyright in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Computer programs are included in 'literary works' and protectable by copyright.

questions.question: How do I register copyright in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Apply to Copyright Office, Form XIV, fee, examination, registration.

questions.question: What is fair use or fair dealing in Indian copyright law?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 52 lists permitted acts: research, private study, criticism, review, reporting, education.

questions.question: Does copyright need to be registered in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Registration is not mandatory but provides prima facie evidence of ownership.

questions.question: What is moral right in Indian copyright?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Right of paternity (attribution) and right of integrity survive even after assignment.

questions.question: What is copyright infringement and what are the remedies?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Civil remedies (injunction, damages) and criminal remedies (imprisonment up to 3 years, fine).

questions.question: मेरी कविता का कॉपीराइट कितने साल तक रहेगा?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Author's lifetime + 60 years.

questions.question: What is an industrial design and how is it protected?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A design relates to features of shape, configuration, pattern applied to an article by industrial process.

questions.question: How do I register a design in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: File application with design drawings/photographs, pay fee, examination, registration.

questions.question: How long is design registration valid in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years initially, extendable by 5 more years. Maximum 15 years.

questions.question: Can I protect my product packaging as a design in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Yes, if novel and original. Trade dress can also qualify.

questions.question: What cannot be registered as a design in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Not new or original, contrary to public order or morality, prior publication.

questions.question: What is a geographical indication?
questions.ground_truth_notes: GI identifies a product as originating from a specific geographical region with qualities attributable to that region.

questions.question: Can an individual register a GI in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Only an association of persons, producers' organization, or authority can register a GI, not an individual.

questions.question: What is Darjeeling tea's status as a GI?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Darjeeling tea was India's first GI product (GI application no. 1).

questions.question: How long is GI registration valid?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years, renewable.

questions.question: What is the SICLD Act 2000?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design Act 2000 protects original layout-designs of ICs.

questions.question: How long is semiconductor IC layout design protection valid?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years from date of registration or first commercial exploitation.

questions.question: What is the difference between a patent and a trademark?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patent protects inventions (20 years). Trademark protects brand identifiers (10 years, renewable).

questions.question: Patent aur copyright mein kya antar hai?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patent: inventions, 20 years, registration required. Copyright: creative works, lifetime+60 years, automatic.

questions.question: Which IP protection is best for my mobile app?
questions.expected_provision: Copyright Act 1957, Patents Act 1970, Trade Marks Act 1999
questions.ground_truth_notes: Code: copyright. Brand name/logo: trademark. Novel technical feature: patent. Multiple forms may apply.

questions.question: What IP protections are available for a startup?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patents, trademarks, copyright, designs. DPIIT-recognized startups get fee rebates.

questions.question: What is DPIIT recognition for startups?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Startups can apply for DPIIT recognition to access tax benefits, self-certification, fast-track IP.

questions.question: Do startups get any IP fee discounts in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Startups recognized by DPIIT get 80% rebate on patent fees and 50% on trademark fees.

questions.question: What is the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023?
questions.ground_truth_notes: India's primary law for protection of digital personal data, establishing rights of data principals and obligations of data fiduciaries.

questions.question: What are the rights of data principals under DPDP Act 2023?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Right to access, correct, erase personal data; right to grievance redressal; right to nominate.

questions.question: What is consent under the DPDP Act 2023?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, unambiguous.

questions.question: डेटा प्रोटेक्शन बोर्ड क्या है?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Data Protection Board of India is the adjudicating body under the DPDP Act.

questions.question: What is a patent attorney and do I need one in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A patent agent registered with the Indian Patent Office can represent applicants.

questions.question: What is PCT and can Indian applicants use it?
questions.ground_truth_notes: PCT = Patent Cooperation Treaty. Indian applicants can file PCT applications through IP India.

questions.question: What is the examination process for a patent in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Substantive examination on request, First Examination Report (FER), applicant responds, then grant or refusal.

questions.question: What is a trade secret and is it protected in India?
questions.expected_provision: No specific statute — common law protection
questions.ground_truth_notes: India has no specific trade secret law; protection through common law, contract, and equity.

questions.question: Can I assign my patent to another person in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Yes, assignments must be in writing and recorded with the Patent Office.

questions.question: What is patent licensing and how does it work?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patentee can grant voluntary licenses. Compulsory licenses available after 3 years on specific grounds.

questions.question: What are the requirements for a valid trademark in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Must be distinctive, capable of graphical representation, identify source of goods/services.

questions.question: ट्रेडमार्क कितने साल के लिए वैध होता है?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years, renewal for further 10-year periods.

questions.question: What is trademark passing off in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Common law action for unregistered marks. Requires goodwill, misrepresentation, damage.

questions.question: How do I search existing trademarks in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Use IP India's online trademark search at ipindiaonline.gov.in/tmrpublicsearch

questions.question: Can a sound be registered as a trademark in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Yes, non-traditional marks including sounds are registrable if distinctive.

questions.question: What is the Nice Classification for trademarks?
questions.ground_truth_notes: International classification of goods and services (Classes 1-45). India follows Nice Classification.

questions.question: Copyright kitne saal mein expire hota hai?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Author ki life + 60 years.

questions.question: What happens if I use copyrighted material without permission in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Civil: injunction, damages. Criminal: imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

questions.question: Can I copyright a recipe in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: The expression of a recipe (as written text) can be copyrighted but not the recipe itself (the idea).

questions.question: What are Locarno classes for design registration?
questions.ground_truth_notes: International classification system for industrial designs used in India.

questions.question: Can I cancel a registered design in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Any person can petition for cancellation to High Court on grounds like prior publication, not novel, etc.

questions.question: How many GIs are registered in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Over 600 GIs registered as of recent data. [Note: verify current count from GI Registry]

questions.question: What is the opposition process for GI registration?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Published in GI Journal. Opposition can be filed within 3 months of publication.

questions.question: What is a data fiduciary under DPDP Act?
questions.ground_truth_notes: An entity that determines the purpose and means of processing personal data.

questions.question: What are the penalties under the DPDP Act 2023?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Up to Rs 250 crore for not implementing reasonable security safeguards; various other penalties.

questions.question: I created a new machine. What IP protection options do I have?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patent for novel technical aspects. Design for aesthetic appearance. Copyright for drawings. Trademark for brand.

questions.question: टेक्नोलॉजी स्टार्टअप के लिए कौन सी आईपी सुरक्षा सबसे उपयुक्त है?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patent for core technology, trademark for brand, copyright for code.

questions.question: What is the Patent Office in India and where is it located?
questions.ground_truth_notes: The Patent Office operates under CGPDTM. Head office in Kolkata; branch offices in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai.

questions.question: What is an expedited examination of a patent application?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Available for DPIIT startups, women inventors, small entities; request within 48 months.

questions.question: Can a foreign company apply for a patent in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Yes, foreign applicants can file through an Indian resident patent agent.

questions.question: What is the Trade Marks Journal?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Official publication where accepted trademark applications are advertised before registration.

questions.question: What is a certification trademark in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A mark used to certify the quality or origin of goods (like ISI mark, Agmark).

questions.question: What is collective trademark in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A mark distinguishing goods/services of members of an association from those of others.

questions.question: Can I trademark a colour in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Colors can be registered if distinctive for the goods/services. Single color is harder; color combination easier.

questions.question: What is Section 3 of the Patents Act about?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 3 lists what are not inventions: discoveries, mental acts, business methods, traditional knowledge, etc.

questions.question: ডিজাইন রেজিস্ট্রেশন কত বছরের জন্য বৈধ?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years, extendable by 5 years.

questions.question: What is working of a patent requirement in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Patentees must file annual working statements (Form 27) showing extent of working in India.

questions.question: ట్రేడ్‌మార్క్ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ఎంత కాలానికి అయ్యాక రిన్యూ చేయాలి?
questions.ground_truth_notes: 10 years after registration or last renewal.

questions.question: What is TRIPs and how does it affect Indian IP law?
questions.expected_provision: India's IP laws amended to comply with TRIPs
questions.ground_truth_notes: TRIPs is WTO agreement on IP. India amended its IP laws in 2002-2005 to comply.

questions.question: Can AI-generated inventions be patented in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Current Indian law requires the inventor to be a natural person. AI as sole inventor not recognized.

questions.question: What is a plant variety protection in India?
questions.expected_provision: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001
questions.ground_truth_notes: PPVFRA provides sui generis protection for new plant varieties, distinct from patents.

questions.question: What are the documents required for trademark registration?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Application form TM-A, representation of the mark, list of goods/services, POA if filed through agent, user affidavit if claiming prior use.

questions.question: पेटेंट के लिए Form 1 क्या होता है?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Form 1 is the application for grant of patent in India.

questions.question: What is the Copyright Office in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: The Copyright Office is headed by the Registrar of Copyrights. Based in New Delhi.

questions.question: Can I use someone else's trademark in comparative advertising in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Comparative advertising may be permitted if not misleading. Section 30 covers permitted acts.

questions.question: What is a well-known trademark in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: A mark known to substantial segment of the public in India. Gets protection across all classes.

questions.question: What is a design piracy and what are its consequences?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Applying a registered design without license is piracy. Civil remedy: damages up to Rs 50,000 or injunction.

questions.question: How do I register a GI product in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Apply to GI Registry, Geographical Indications Registry is in Chennai.

questions.question: What is Section 9 of the Trade Marks Act?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Absolute grounds for refusal of registration.

questions.question: Can I patent a business method in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: No. Business methods are excluded from patentability under Section 3(k).

questions.question: स्टार्टअप को पेटेंट फाइल करने में कितना खर्च आता है?
questions.ground_truth_notes: DPIIT-recognized startups get 80% fee reduction. Current fee per form varies.

questions.question: What quantum computing patents exist in India?
questions.ground_truth_notes: This question may exceed the knowledge base scope — system should indicate insufficient evidence.

questions.question: What is the exact fee for filing Form TM-A for a trademark in India today?
questions.expected_provision: Trade Marks Rules, 2017 — Schedule of Fees
questions.ground_truth_notes: Current fee is in the Trade Marks Rules schedule. System should cite rule, not fabricate number.

questions.question: Who invented the internet?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Out of scope question — system should gracefully indicate this is outside the IP/regulatory domain.
